sources.locator: "German–Soviet Boundary and Friendship Treaty", revision 1375965836, § lead and § Secret articles

explanation: The English article opens by calling the treaty "a second supplementary protocol of the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact of 23 August 1939", amended on 28 September 1939 after the joint German and Soviet invasion and occupation of Poland, superseding the first treaty. Its secret articles redrew parts of the spheres of interest the pact had dictated and moved Lithuania into the Soviet sphere to compensate for Polish territory the Wehrmacht had taken. There is no treaty of 28 September without the pact it supplements.
